body:
# Web & Mobile Outsourcing Pricing — 3 SME Packages in Hanoi

Public pricing from Cross Tech Edu for small businesses in Hanoi: outsourced web design, mobile app and backend development. No hidden tiers, no setup fee, no management fee.

## Dedicated developers — USD per developer per month
- Junior (1–2 years): from 300 USD — executes pre-scoped tasks under review from a middle developer or above.
- Middle (3–5 years, most popular): from 600 USD — owns modules end-to-end, reviews code for juniors.
- Senior (5+ years): from 1,200 USD — designs architecture, leads the team, works directly with your CTO.

## Fixed-price projects — USD
- Company website: 39 USD — 5 pages, responsive, domain and first-year hosting, delivered in 5 days.
- Web app: from 230 USD — login, roles, dashboard, API and documentation, usually 3–6 weeks.
- Mobile app: from 1,150 USD — iOS and Android with Flutter, backend included, published to both stores, 6–10 weeks.

## Case study summary
Order management web app for a Hanoi food SME: handed over in 4 weeks, running on your staging from the second sprint.

## CTA
Book a free 30-minute consultation or request a detailed quote within 48 hours.

## Internal links
[Web & mobile outsourcing](/en/outsourcing-web-mobile-small-business-hanoi/) · [Book a 30-minute call](#contact) · [Blog](/en/blog/)
